column1: # r2 reviewed 2026-10-26: kept 18, renamed 7, reverted 0 (3 func_ named)

column3: Resets the HUD origin and clip bounds, the info-panel, spell-name and allocation timers, and other HUD counters; called from 1870 on area setup.

Sets the HUD projection and, by game/battle flags, draws the HP/MP bars, element levels, compass, popups, target/prompt markers, status icons, spell input and element allocation; in 1870's frame display-list build.

Draws two stat pairs of the player as bars (width eases toward value*56/max) with current/max numbers: +4 of +6 (HP: Player_TakeDamage subtracts from it, 0 sends Player_StateHurt to the dying state) and +8 of +A (MP: Player_StartCastSpell pays the spell cost from it, walking refills it up to +A)

Draws the four element levels (stats +0x24..+0x27, the values Hud_UpdateElementAllocation raises) with icons, a pulsing symbol for each element flagged at 50 (player flags 0x1000 << i) and a fading highlight on the last raised one.
Draws a graphic rotated by the camera yaw D_80085E74 and, when a target point D_8008FB48/4C is set and over 10 units away, a marker at its direction relative to the camera.
Draws the four choices (the spell the sequence would become with each element appended, Hud_DrawSpellLabel) and the current up-to-three-element sequence, with slide/fade transitions.
Looks up the name of the spell id at player +0x122 (D_800C03D8 table) and draws it centered in a panel; shown for 30 frames after Player_StartCastSpell.

Active while D_8004DCA0 & 8 (set on spirit pickup or spirit-level up): draws the four element levels; a C button raises that element by 1 (cap 50, sets flag 0x1000 << i at 50, 0x10000 when all four are), plays a sound and clears the mode.
D_8007A9C0 is Player_FindNpcToTalk's result: projects that NPC (D_8007ABF0 entry) to screen and draws a bobbing sprite above it.
Drawn by Hud_Draw while D_8007A9C4 (Spirit_FindInFront's result) is set: a bobbing sprite above the player.
Drawn by Hud_Draw while D_8007A9C8 (Chest_FindInFront's result) is set: a bobbing sprite above the player.
Drawn by Hud_Draw while D_8007A9CC (TextSpot_FindInFront's result) is set: a bobbing sprite above the player.
Hud_Draw passes the player's melee target (PlayerState.unk2 = Player_FindMeleeTarget's 1 + index) on the player's turn: projects that enemy's top to screen and draws a bobbing marker.

Drawn while player flag 0x20 is set, which Player_MoveAndCollide sets when the player is outside the battle circle D_8008BE6C in a non-boss battle (Battle_UpdateTurnTransition then ends the battle without rewards); icon above the player's head.
For a status mask: records an icon index and duration in the actor's slot and, for the four effect masks, creates an attached visual effect (Magic_CreateVisualEffect).
Draws the actor's active status icons above it, expires icons and attached effects whose status bit is gone or whose duration ran out, and moves the attached effects with the actor.
Clears all status-icon slots and ends any attached visual effects.

Draws for 60 frames the enemy whose turn just started (Enemy_StateIdle sets D_8007C028 = that enemy and D_8008C162 = 60): its name from D_8007C04C (the enemy name table Battle_StartBossEncounter swaps for bosses) and, for enemies flagged 0x80, four stat values.
Clears every entry in the eight-slot popup pool.
Allocates a 45-frame popup attached to an actor (fixed sprite region 41x14) at its top; called by Player_StartDodge and Enemy_PlayMissEffect.
Projects each timed popup's world position and draws its sprite, counting the timer down.
Looks up the spell for an element sequence, gets its restriction flags, and draws its name (or a placeholder when flag 4) with a palette by flags.
Draws 0xFF-terminated glyph bytes from the HUD font texture, with control bytes 0x80/0x81 (marks) and 0x82 (space).
Sums glyph widths and control-byte spacing until the 0xFF terminator.
Formats an integer (Text_FormatNumber) and draws each digit from the HUD texture.
Loads an 8-bit or 4-bit color-indexed texture tile from a texture descriptor.
Offsets the rectangle by the HUD origin D_8008C174/178, clips it to the HUD bounds and emits a texture-rectangle command.
Loads a texture tile and draws it at the requested rectangle.
